text: Coffee with Lena. Her dad's funeral is Thursday at 11 at St Mary's. She's holding up but her sister Angela is a wreck. I'll drop food round the day before.

Long catch up with Adebayo after work. He starts at the council on Monday, first day is 9am sharp, and he's already ironed three shirts. His wife Chioma is 30 weeks pregnant so it's a lot at once, and her mum is flying in from Lagos the week after. He says he's fine but kept checking his phone. Text him Monday evening to see how it went.
Dana got made redundant on Friday. Didn't see it coming, eleven years there. She's putting a brave face on it but she's clearly struggling. Must check in with her next week.
Uma and Arturo are expecting! Due in March. She's had awful morning sickness though. He's already painting the nursery.
Nasser's leaving do is the 14th at half 6, the Crown. He's retiring after 32 years at the depot. Collection going round, chip in by Wednesday.
Chat with Teresa. The christening is Sunday the 9th at 10am and she wants me to do a reading. Lunch at her mum's afterwards. Her little one is called Rosa.
Alana and Jakub have split up. Six years. She's moved back to her mum's in Leeds for now. Don't mention Jakub to her for a while, and call her at the weekend.
Tunde got the promotion! Head of logistics from November. His boss Mrs Williams pushed for him apparently. Send congrats.
Quick one: Aoife's baby arrived this morning at 4am, a girl, 7lb 2oz. Mum and baby fine. Card and something small for the baby.
Irina's grandmother passed away last night. Funeral's back in Kraków, she flies out Tuesday morning. Her partner Ivan is going with her. Check in a week after she's back.

Elif starts her new job at the hospital tomorrow morning. Nervous about the night shifts, she's never done them before and her last place was days only. Her girlfriend Aoife is a nurse too so at least someone gets it. She's vegetarian, remember for the welcome lunch thing on Friday at 1.
Lunch with Bilal and Abdi. Bilal's interview for the senior role is Friday at 3pm, then they're telling him the next day. Abdi has a new puppy called Biscuit. Text Bilal good luck Thursday night.
Rahul's last day at the bank is Friday. Leaving drinks after at 5. He's going freelance, scary but excited. His wife Vera is due in January too, so brave timing.
Olivia rang. Her uncle died suddenly on Saturday. She's going up to Glasgow for the funeral on the 23rd. I said I'd feed her cat Pickle while she's away.
Giulia's wedding anniversary next week, 10 years. Her husband Kaito is planning a surprise weekend in Lisbon. Don't say anything to her!

Kasia had the baby scan yesterday afternoon, all looking good. Twins!! She's due late spring. Her mum is moving over from Poland to help afterwards, probably for six months. Her husband Abdi nearly fainted apparently. They're going to have to sell the Fiat and get something bigger.
Lucy was made redundant, then the next day got offered a job at the competitor. Starts the 3rd at 8.30. Lucky her.
Sat with Mandla for ages. His mum's in hospice now, they think a couple of weeks. He's not sleeping. Ring him tomorrow morning before his shift, and offer to take his kids Saturday.
Emeka's retirement party was supposed to be the 18th but it's off, his wife's in hospital. Ask Femi how she's doing.
Femi and his partner are going for adoption. Panel is the 30th at 2pm. Very anxious. Wish them luck the day before.
Christening for Alice's son on the 2nd at half 11. Godparents are me and Lola. Need to get a silver something, she hinted at a christening bangle.
Bought sympathy cards, posted the one for Lena. Still need stamps.
Teresa Smith from work said her husband's company is laying off half the office in January. He's got the meeting the 12th at half 9. She's worried sick. Keep an eye on her.

Adebayo's first week went well apparently, he loves the team and they took him for curry on Friday. His manager is called Lola, she's ex army and terrifying but fair. Chioma's baby shower is the Saturday after next at 2, at her sister Dana's place. Need to ask what's on the list, and I should offer to help set up that morning.
Angela Lee, everyone calls her Angie, is retiring end of December. Thirty years teaching. Wants to take up pottery. Maybe a pottery class voucher as a leaving gift?
Didn't get to talk to Dana properly at the party, she left early. Text her tomorrow.

Arturo's dad had a fall Sunday night, hip surgery Wednesday at 7am. Arturo is driving down the night before and staying in a Travelodge. Uma's staying home because of the pregnancy, she's gutted not to go. His dad is 84 and stubborn, refuses to use a stick. Ring Arturo Wednesday afternoon once he's out of theatre.
Met Nasser's daughter Alana for the first time. She's a midwife at the Royal. Really lovely, into wild swimming.
Note for myself: start the new role on the 1st, induction 9 till 1 that morning, then lunch with the team afterwards.
Vera had the baby! Little boy, Theo, born Tuesday at 6pm. Rahul is on paternity for two weeks. Pop round with a lasagne once they've settled, maybe the weekend after.
Jakub messaged. He's taking the breakup harder than he lets on, drinking a bit. His brother Ivan is staying with him. Should meet him for a pint Friday at 8.
Irina is back from Poland. She said the funeral was beautiful but exhausting, and the next day she had to go straight back to work. Ask how she's sleeping.

Kaito got the job in Osaka! He moves in February, Giulia is following in the summer once her contract ends. Leaving drinks probably mid January, he'll send dates. He's been after this for years, it's basically his dream job. He collects old film cameras, gift idea. Also he's a terrible packer so offer to help the weekend before he goes.
Elif's first week at the hospital was rough. She cried after her second night shift. Her mentor Dr Ahmed seems kind though. Message her Sunday.
Got the cat food for Olivia's cat. She's back Monday.
Bilal didn't get the job. They phoned the next day like they said. He's gutted but says it's fine. Take him out for lunch next week.
Abdi's sister Kasia, the one from book club, is pregnant with number three. Due in June. Their eldest starts nursery in January too.
Mandla's mum passed away on Monday evening. The funeral is next Friday at 1pm at the crematorium, wake after at the rugby club. I'm taking Femi. Send flowers to his house before the weekend.
Chioma went into labour early, two weeks before the shower. Baby girl, both fine, in for a couple of nights. Adebayo is over the moon. Shower's cancelled obviously.
Lola told me she's leaving the army after 15 years and starting at a security firm on the 4th. Her partner Lucy is thrilled to have her home. Congratulate her when I see her Saturday.
Called Aoife. The baby's not feeding well and she's exhausted. Her husband goes back to work Monday. Her sister Alana is coming the next day to help. I should drop round Wednesday afternoon.
Tunde's promotion party is Saturday at 7. His wife Giulia is doing the food. Bring wine.
Angela said the funeral went as well as it could. Lena read the eulogy. They're scattering the ashes in the spring, at the beach their dad loved. Follow up with Lena in a couple of weeks.
Femi and Mandla were at the funeral together, nice to see. Femi has just started a PhD in marine biology, three days a week in Plymouth. Mandla's son Tunde is off to uni next September.
Tomorrow morning: bank at 9, then pick up suit from dry cleaners for the funeral Friday.
Irina's partner Ivan proposed while they were in Poland! Wedding probably next summer. She's going to ask me to be a bridesmaid. Engagement drinks the 21st at 8.
Uma's 20 week scan is Thursday at 10.15. It's a girl. She's been really anxious since the last one, so text her Thursday afternoon after the scan.
Arturo's dad came through the surgery fine. Out of hospital the week after. Arturo is staying with him until then, working remotely. Uma says the house is chaos without him.
Dana's update: three interviews lined up. First one is Monday at 2pm at a charity. She's applying for anything. Her husband Emeka has been brilliant. Send her the job link from Rahul.
Teresa's husband kept his job after all. The meeting on the 12th was just a restructure. Relief all round.

Nasser at his leaving do, very emotional speech, half the depot was in tears. He and his wife are going to Morocco for a month in January, then he's building a shed and finally learning to play the oud. His grandson Femi gave a little speech too. Loved the whisky we got him.
Lucy's started at the new place. Hates the commute, 90 minutes each way, but the people are nice. She's thinking of moving closer next year.
Alice is pregnant again! Only just told her mum. Due in May, same month as Abdi's lot. She's worried about juggling a toddler. Remind me to ask how the 12 week scan goes on the 8th.

Quick call with Kasia. Her mum arrived from Poland the day before the twins came. Babies are Zofia and Jan, born Saturday morning, a bit small but fine. Must sort a gift, she said nappies are what they really need.

Rahul hasn't been sleeping with the new baby and freelance work has dried up. He's really stressed about money. Vera's back at work in March. Check in with him next week, and ask Femi if his firm needs anyone.
Jakub's moving out of the flat he shared with Alana on the 30th. Ivan and I are helping that morning with the van. He's found a room in Leith.
Note: Angela's retirement do is the 19th of December at 4pm in the school hall, then dinner after at the Italian. Booked the table for 8.

Had a proper heart to heart with Giulia last night. Kaito's job means leaving her mum, who's not well, Parkinson's. She hasn't decided if she'll go. She's torn and not sleeping. Her brother Emeka thinks she should stay. I'll call her at the weekend and just listen. Also her birthday is on the 2nd and she's mentioned wanting a proper Japanese cookbook, could be nice given everything.

Lena's mum is moving in with her after the funeral, which Lena is fine with but her husband isn't keen. Lena is going back to work the Monday after next, part time for a month. Her boss has been really decent. She says she's okay but she clearly isn't. Their dog Rolo keeps waiting by the door for her dad. Check in on her the week she goes back, and take her for a walk with Rolo on Sunday morning.
Picked up the christening gift for Teresa's Rosa and wrapped it. Done.
